system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: In practice, we support flexible prompts to organize the action space into system messages. By default, we adopt the Qwen function calling format.
system_prompt_style.note: Mobile-Agent-v3 harness code not in the evidence bundle; the only prompt code shown is the v3.5 browser_use agent and PC-Agent. Paper describes the system message defining the action space.

env_context_strategy.note: The Mobile-Agent-v3 agent code is not in the bundle. The paper mentions a RAG module ('Retrieved Knowledge') for the Manager, and screenshots as observations. It gives no default config.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: To save GPU memory and improve inference speed, we typically retain only the most recent 1 to 3 images.
context_compaction.note: The paper also says 'only the conclusion is stored in the historical context' (per-step summaries). Coded from paper prose describing GUI-Owl interaction. Harness code not available.

tool_call_format.note: Figure 3 shows the action as a JSON {"name": "computer_use", ...} in the response. Closest value is json_in_text; this may be emitted inside <tool_call> tags. Parser code not in bundle.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: terminate Terminate the current task and report its completion status: success or failure.
termination_condition.note: The paper also notes 'all tasks limited to a maximum of 15 steps' in the OSWorld eval (Sec. 5.2). The minimal_task_runner step loop is the AndroidWorld T3A baseline, not v3.

execution_isolation.note: Actions are executed via ADB or pyautogui on devices/VMs. The paper mentions cloud phones and computers. There is no deployment config in the bundle.

tracing.note: The excerpt is AndroidWorld run code using absl logging. The locator path is uncertain: the excerpt does not give the file name, and no structured trace was seen.
